王建新回到土坯房，把青马收入空间，自己也一头扎了进去。

空间里亮堂堂的，他站在河边，看着满满当当的收获，开心坏了。

这次出去，收获太大了。

仓库里的物资、办公室里的家当、车场里的车辆，还有那些牲畜，全在空间里堆着。面粉袋子摞成了小山，拖拉机、卡车、摩托车排成一排，几头牛和马站在河边的草地上，东张西望的。

王建新走过去看了看那些牲畜。

牛和马倒是老实，站在草地上安安静静的。但那些羊就不一样了——有几只羊不知道什么时候跑到地里正在土豆地里啃秧子。

“嘿！”

王建新赶忙跑过去，把那几只羊从地里赶了出来，轰到河这边来。他蹲下来看了看土豆地，心疼坏了——土豆秧子被啃得乱七八糟的，叶子缺了好几个大窟窿。

好在他用手扒了扒土，发现土豆已经长得不小了。拳头大的，一个个结在根上，看着就喜人。

“看来今天能把它们全挖出来了。”王建新自言自语。

但他没急着挖土豆，先干别的。

他得把这些物资好好归置归置，分门别类放好。不然堆得乱七八糟的，找东西都不好找。

王建新撸起袖子开始干活。

他把面粉、糖、油这些吃的放在一起，码在种植的一块空地上。布匹、成衣、鞋帽这些穿戴的，摞在旁边。日用品归一堆，香皂、牙膏、搪瓷盆、暖水瓶什么的。

农具和机械放在另一块地方。拖拉机停好，播种机、犁、铁锹、镐、锄头靠着边缘位置整齐摆放。发电机、水泵、电焊机挨着放。水泥、钢材、木材、玻璃、油漆这些建材，堆在最边上。

化肥和油桶单独放，这东西有味，不能跟吃的搁一块。

车辆单独停了一片。嘎斯69、卡车、两辆边三轮摩托车，一字排开。

牲畜就放在河对岸的牧草地上，让它们自己吃草。牛马羊加起来四五十头，散在草地上，倒也和谐。

光整理这些东西就花了他大半天工夫。王建新直起腰，擦了擦汗，看着整整齐齐的空间，心里美滋滋的。

接下来是重头戏——布置住的地方。

王建新挑了一块平整的地方，离河边不远，地势稍微高一点，他从那堆物资里找出几块帆布，铺在地上，大概铺了百来平米。又在帆布上面铺了几块地毯，厚实，踩上去软乎乎的。

然后把从办公室里收来的床、衣柜、办公桌、沙发、茶几全摆上。

床靠着“墙”放——其实没有墙，就是空间边缘的白雾，但无所谓。衣柜放在床边上，办公桌摆在靠中间的位置——得有个办公的地方。沙发和茶几摆在另一边，算是会客区，虽然没有别人，但生活总要有仪式感嘛。

铺盖是从休息室收来的那套，被褥叠得整整齐齐的，铺在床上一试——哎呀，真舒服，上面铺上新的床单和自己的被子。

王建新往床上一躺，整个人陷在被褥里，浑身的骨头都松了。

在草原上住了这么久，先是苏和家的蒙古包，硬邦邦的地铺，然后是土坯房的土炕，硬得硌人。现在终于有了张正经床，还有软和的被褥。

“这才是人过的日子。”王建新躺在床上，长长地舒了一口气。

躺了一会儿，他爬起来，开始整理那些铁皮柜和办公桌的抽屉。

得翻翻，看看有没有意外收获。

先打开那个装武器的大铁柜子。

柜门一开，王建新的眼睛就亮了。

柜子里整整齐齐地码着枪支。

AK47，十支。枪身乌黑锃亮，崭新的，看着就没怎么用过。

SKS，十支。半自动，比AK长一点，枪托是木头的，擦得油光锃亮。

莫辛-纳甘，十支。老式步枪，枪管很长，带着老派的庄重感。

还有一把波波沙——PPSH-41冲锋枪，枪管外面的散热孔密密麻麻的，弹鼓圆滚滚的，一看就是老家伙，但保养得很好。

Wang Jianxin returned to the adobe house, put the green horse into the space, and plunged in himself.

The space was bright, and he stood by the river, looking at the harvest, and he was very happy.

This time I went out and gained so much.

The materials in the warehouse, the belongings in the office, the vehicles in the yard, and the livestock are all piled up in the space.Flour bags were piled up into a hill, tractors, trucks, and motorcycles were lined up. Several cows and horses stood on the grass by the river, looking around.

Wang Jianxin walked over and took a look at the livestock.

The cows and horses were honest and stood quietly on the grass.But those sheep were different - a few sheep ran into the field at some point and were gnawing on seedlings in the potato field.

"Hey!"

Wang Jianxin ran over quickly, drove the sheep out of the field, and rushed them to the river.He knelt down and looked at the potato field, and was heartbroken - the potato seedlings were chewed into a mess, and the leaves were missing several big holes.

Fortunately, he dug up the soil with his hands and found that the potatoes had grown quite big.The fist-sized ones are knotted one by one at the roots, which is pleasing to look at.

"It seems we can dig them all out today." Wang Jianxin said to himself.

But he was not in a hurry to dig potatoes and did other things first.

He had to arrange these materials properly and put them into categories.Otherwise, it will be piled up in a mess and it will be difficult to find anything.

Wang Jianxin rolled up his sleeves and started working.

He put flour, sugar, oil and other food together and piled them on a clearing for planting.Cloth, ready-made clothes, shoes and hats, and other items of clothing were piled next to them.Daily necessities are piled in a pile, such as soap, toothpaste, enamel basins, thermos bottles and so on.

Farm tools and machinery were kept in another area.The tractor is parked, and the planter, plow, shovel, pick, and hoe are neatly placed against the edge.Generators, water pumps, and welding machines are placed next to each other.Building materials such as cement, steel, wood, glass, and paint are piled on the edge.

Fertilizer and oil drums should be placed separately. They are smelly and should not be placed with food.

The vehicle stopped alone.GAZ 69, a truck, and two three-wheeled motorcycles were lined up.

The livestock were placed on the pasture on the other side of the river and allowed to graze on their own.A total of forty or fifty cattle, horses and sheep were scattered on the grass, which was quite harmonious.

It took him most of the day just to sort out these things.Wang Jianxin straightened up, wiped his sweat, and looked at the neat space, feeling pleased with himself.

Next comes the main event – ​​decorating the place to live.

Wang Jianxin picked a flat place, not far from the river, with slightly higher terrain. He found a few pieces of canvas from the pile of supplies and spread them on the ground, covering about a hundred square meters.A few more carpets were spread on top of the canvas. They were thick and soft when stepped on.

Then put the bed, wardrobe, desk, sofa, and coffee table collected from the office.

The bed is placed against the "wall" - in fact there is no wall, just a white mist at the edge of the space, but it doesn't matter.The wardrobe is placed next to the bed, and the desk is placed in the middle - there must be a place to work.The sofa and coffee table are placed on the other side, which is regarded as the reception area. Although there is no one else, life must have a sense of ritual.

The bedding was the one collected from the lounge, and the quilts were folded neatly. I tried laying them on the bed - oh, it's so comfortable. I put new sheets and my own quilt on top.

Wang Jianxin lay down on the bed, his whole body sank into the quilt, and all the bones in his body were loose.

After living on the grassland for so long, first the yurt of Su He's family had a hard floor, and then the adobe kang of the adobe house was so hard.Now I finally have a decent bed and soft quilts.

"This is how people live." Wang Jianxin lay on the bed and let out a long sigh of relief.

After lying down for a while, he got up and began to organize the drawers of the iron cabinets and desks.

I have to look through it to see if there are any unexpected gains.

First open the big iron cabinet containing weapons.

As soon as the cabinet door opened, Wang Jianxin's eyes lit up.

The guns were neatly stacked in the cabinet.

AK47, ten pieces.The gun body was shiny black and brand new, and it looked like it had not been used much.

SKS, ten pieces.Semi-automatic, a little longer than the AK, the butt is made of wood and polished to a shiny finish.

Mosin-Nagant, ten branches.An old-fashioned rifle with a long barrel and an old-school sense of solemnity.

There is also a Bobosha-PPSH-41 submachine gun. The outside of the barrel has dense heat dissipation holes and the drum is round. It looks like an old guy at first glance, but it is well maintained.
